key_catalyst: U.S.-Iran military escalation and Strait of Hormuz closure driving oil surge and inflation fears
reasoning: The U.S.-Iran military escalation and Hormuz closure remain unresolved, with oil prices surging above $85/barrel and inflation fears reigniting. Despite a modest pre-market bounce on July 14-15, the intraday reversal on July 14 and ongoing semiconductor weakness indicate the market has not absorbed the risk; the catalysts are still escalating and carry forward risk.
